title: Issue and revoke sessions
acceptance:
Story: a member signs in with their key and works under a session the admin can end.
Expected: POST /sessions exchanges an account key for a session token; DELETE on a session signs out its caller; an admin can revoke any member session; revoked tokens stop working immediately.
Not expected: passwords, passkeys, expiry timers or multi-device session management; those belong to 0.3.
Depends on: WI-12 accounts and the WI-10 store.
Verify: acceptance signs in, works, is revoked, and then receives 401.
evidence: POST /sessions exchanges an account key for a session; DELETE revokes the caller or any session as admin; revoked tokens answer 401 immediately (node test and verify.py). PR #6: https://github.com/chakibelbassam/FoundationOS/pull/6.
